text.p: One of the most colourful characters of Sydney early this century was KATE LEIGH, who was born on this day in 1881. She ran a sly-grog shop in Surrey Hills, and was known as "The Rugged Angel" after killing one gangster and shooting another.
French composer ARTHUR HONEGGER was born in 1892.
American star of the jazz era BIX (LEON BISMARK) BEIDERBECKE, a supreme cornet player and composer, was born in 1903.
Author of "All Creatures Great And Small", JAMES HERRIOT, was born in 1916. He died in February 1995.
Australian historian ALAN GEOFFREY SERLE was born on this day in 1922.
West Australian and VFL footballer GRAHAM "POLLY" FARMER was born on this day in 1935.
British singer TINA CHARLES (TINA HOSKINS) was born in 1955. She had hits with songs such as "I LOve To Love" (1976), "Dance Little Lady Dance" (1976) and "Dr Love" (1976).
US singer/songwriter NENEH CHERRY was born in 1964. Her solo hits included "Buffalo Stance" (1988) and "Man Child" (1989). INTERRUPTED
